answers.question: I missed Thursday and cut the long run short. Should I make up the miles next week?

new.analysis: The athlete missed the Thursday easy run and ran 11 miles instead of the planned 13 for Sunday. The total volume for the week was 27 miles, 2 miles short of the 29‑mile goal.  HR drift on the easy runs was high, indicating fatigue and heat stress.  They are in the build phase, so next week should recover the missing mileage without adding extra hard work and keep the quality session single.  A 5‑mile easy run on Thursday is a simple way to replace the missed run, and the long run should return to 13 miles.  Keep each easy run under 150 HR, especially on hot days, and monitor the HR drift for recovery.  The weekly plan keeps volume steady at ~30 miles and the single quality day on Wednesday.
